items.name: Pita
items.description: Fresh-baked and served warm, our pita puffs in a blazing oven and comes out soft, pillowy, and made for scooping. Nothing like the grocery store version.

items.name: Hummus
items.description: Slow-simmered chickpeas blended with tahini, lemon, and garlic until impossibly smooth, finished with a pour of olive oil, pine nuts, and sumac.

items.name: Zhug
items.description: The fiery Yemenite green condiment: cilantro, parsley, hot chilies, and garlic ground with toasted cardamom, cumin, and coriander. Bright, herbal, and hot. A little goes a long way.

items.name: Baba Ganoush
items.description: Whole eggplants charred over open flame until they collapse, then folded with tahini and lemon. Deeply smoky, silky, and a little rustic.

items.name: Muhammara
items.description: A Syrian spread of roasted red peppers and walnuts with pomegranate molasses and Aleppo pepper. Sweet, tart, nutty, and gently spiced.

items.name: Roasted Za'atar Carrot Dip
items.description: Our signature dish. Carrots roasted with garlic and za'atar until sweet and caramelized, blended with tahini and pistachios, and topped with chopped pistachios and Aleppo pepper. Earthy, warm, rich, and satisfying.
